snippet.title: Vampire's Best Friend reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583530/Vampires_Best_Friend/
and itch: https://sink.itch.io/vampires-best-friend

Vampire hunters are after a mischievous vampire girl, and it's up to her pet bat to save the day. Flap through peril in this open ended precision “batformer” with retro inspired visuals and difficulty.
